title: LoRa L2: propagate TX queue destroy failure during deinit
description: Round-2 correctness review found lichen/subsys/lichen/l2/lora_l2.c logs tx_queue_destroy() failure but still transitions to LORA_UNINIT and returns success. With retryable clear/destroy failures, later init may memset/reinitialize queue and pool synchronization that remains live. Keep the context from becoming reinitializable and propagate the error when queue destruction fails; add lifecycle failure coverage if a suitable seam exists.
acceptance_criteria: lora_deinit (or equivalent) returns the tx_queue_destroy error and does not transition to an uninitialized/reinitializable state on failure; successful deinit behavior remains unchanged; affected tests/builds pass.
close_reason: Implemented and verified by host sanitizer suite plus review cycle; superseding round-4 findings are tracked separately
